blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Previous research shows that vision-language (VL) models struggle to understand fine-grained image details and tend to focus on the overall layout. Moreover, any weakness in English tends to be further amplified in the multilingual setting. To study that, we extend InpaintCOCO, an English dataset focused on fine-grained visual details, to 13 typologically diverse languages across five language families, creating MultiInpaintCOCO - a new multilingual benchmark of 953 minimal-pair examples. We further test several state-of-the-art models in multilingual multimodal retrieval, considering both light VL CLIP-like encoders and large language models. Our results show that performance degrades substantially for lower-resource languages, with the strongest predictor being the data resources available for the languages rather than typological similarity to English. In cross-lingual retrieval, most models exhibit a systematic bias toward English: when given a correct caption in a non-English language and an incorrect one in English, models preferentially select the English caption. This bias varies considerably across architectures. Among the tested models, Gemma 3 shows the strongest English preference while Qwen 3 is the least biased, despite both reaching similar monolingual accuracy across languages. The code is available at https://github.com/ufal/multi-inpaint-coco.
blocks.zh: 先前的研究表明,视觉语言(VL)模型在理解精细的图像细节并倾向于注重整体布局上挣扎. 此外,英语中的任何弱点都倾向于在多语种环境中被进一步扩大. 为了研究这一点,我们将英文数据集InpaintCO扩展至五个语言家庭的13种类型多样的语言,这是953个最小比例例子的新多语种基准。 我们进一步在多语种多模式检索中测试一些最先进的模型,同时考虑轻VL CLIP等编码器和大型语言模型. 我们的结果显示,低资源语言的性能大幅下降,最强的预测器是语言可用的数据资源,而不是与英语的类型相似。 在跨语言检索中,大多数模型对英语表现出系统性的偏向:当给非英语的正确标题和英语的不正确标题时,模型优先选择英语标题. 这种偏见在不同的建筑中差异很大. 在被测试的模型中,Gemma 3表现出最强烈的英语偏好,而Quen 3则是最没有偏见的,尽管两者在语言上都达到了相似的单一语言精度. 该代码可在https://github.com/ufal/multi-inpaint-coco上查阅.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision-language (VL) models take both images and text as input. Depending on the task, two main types of models are currently used. Dual encoders , such as CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) and SigLIP 2 ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) , encode images and texts independently into a shared embedding space; they are the standard choice for retrieval and similarity tasks. Decoder-only models , such as Gemma 3 ( Team et al., 2025 ) and Qwen 2.5-VL ( Bai et al., 2025b ) , are decoder-based and generate text conditioned on both visual and textual input. Both model types are pre-trained on large image-text corpora using objectives (contrastive or generative) that do not require distinguishing between images or captions that differ only in fine-grained details.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言(VL)模型既取图像也取文字作为输入. 根据任务的不同,目前主要使用两种模型. 双重编码器,如CLIP(Radford等,2021年)和SigLIP 2 (Tschannn等,2025年),独立地将图像和文本编码为共享嵌入空间;它们是检索和相似性任务的标准选择. Gemma 3(Team等,2025年)和Quen 2.5-VL(Bai等,2025年b)等只用编码器的模型,都是以可视和文字输入为条件的解码器并生成文本. 两种模型类型在大型图像文本上都经过了预先的训练,使用的目标(相干或相干)不需要区分只有细纹细节上不同的图像或标题.

blocks.en: Several studies have shown that VL models fail to capture fine-grained visual information and instead rely on coarse features, such as global scene layout or the most salient objects ( Fu et al., 2025 ) . To probe this limitation precisely, Rösch et al. (2024) proposes minimal pairs: each example consists of two images that differ by a single inpainted object and two captions that differ by exactly one keyword, so that the correct answer cannot be reached without identifying the specific visual detail. A similar strategy applied at the caption level underlies benchmarks such as SugarCrepe ( Dumpala et al., 2024 ) . The image-editing approach has a key advantage: it introduces genuine visual ambiguity, because neither the image nor the caption alone is sufficient to determine the correct match.
blocks.zh: 一些研究表明,VL模型无法捕捉到细纹视觉信息,而是依赖于粗糙的特征,如全球场景布局或最显著的物体(Fu等,2025年). 为了精确地探究这一局限性,Rösch等人(2024年)提出了最小的对:每个例子由两个图像组成,两个图像因一个被涂入的物体而异,两个标题因一个完全关键词而异,因此如果不识别具体的视觉细节,就无法得到正确的答案. 在标题一级采用的类似战略是诸如 " SugarCrepe " (Dumpla等人,2024年)等基准的基础。 图像编辑方法有一个关键优势:它引入了真实的视觉模糊,因为无论是图像还是标题都不足以确定正确的匹配.

blocks.en: All of this work is English-only. It is well established that VL model performance drops substantially when moving from English to lower-resource languages ( Liu et al., 2021 ; Bugliarello et al., 2022a ) , and that multilingual models are not equally calibrated across languages. Errors in less-resourced languages may therefore not only be more frequent but also qualitatively different. The combination of fine-grained visual understanding and multilingual evaluation is therefore almost entirely unexplored. To close this gap, we extend InpaintCOCO ( Rösch et al., 2024 ) to 13 typologically diverse languages (Azerbaijani, Arabic, Czech, German, Greek, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Ukrainian, Vietnamese), producing the MultiInpaintCOCO dataset. Captions were first translated automatically and then post-edited by native speakers.
blocks.zh: 所有这些作品都是英语独活. 众所周知,VL模型在从英语转向低资源语言时会大幅下降(Liu等人,2021; Bugliarello等人,2022a.),多种语言模型的校正不均. 因此,资源较少的语文错误不仅可能更常见,而且质量也不同。 因此,精细的视觉理解和多语种评价的结合几乎完全没有被探讨. 为了缩小这一差距,我们将InpaintCO(Rösch等人,2024年)扩大到13种类型多样的语言(阿塞拜疆语、阿拉伯语、捷克语、德语、希腊语、印地语、意大利语、日语、罗马尼亚语、俄语、斯洛伐克语、乌克兰语、越南语),制作了MultiInpaintCO数据集。 标题先是自动翻译,后由母语人编辑。

blocks.en: We evaluate several state-of-the-art dual-encoder and generative decoder models on MultiInpaintCOCO and report two main findings. First, performance on lower-resource languages is substantially worse than on English and other high-resource languages, confirming that fine-grained retrieval is harder in the multilingual setting. Second, and more surprisingly, when a model is given one correct caption in a non-English language and one incorrect caption in English, most models systematically prefer the English caption. This bias appears in both dual-encoder and generative decoder-only models, with Azerbaijani the least favored language. The strength of the bias varies considerably across models: Gemma 3 exhibits the strongest preference for English, while Qwen 3 is the least biased. This is not just a reflection of lower overall accuracy in weaker languages. It reveals a systematic preference for English that persists even when the model is otherwise capable of making the correct match.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了MultiInpaintCO的几种最先进的双编码器和基因解码器模型,并报告了两个主要发现。 首先,与英语和其他高资源语言相比,低资源语言的表现要差得多,这证明在多语种环境中,精细的检索比较困难。 第二,更令人惊讶的是,当一个模型被给予一个非英语的正确标题和一个英语的不正确的标题时,大多数模型系统地倾向于英语标题. 这种偏好在双编码器和只以基因为主的解码器模型中都出现,阿塞拜疆语是最受青睐的语言. 不同模型间偏差的强度相差很大:Gemma 3表现出对英语最强烈的偏好,而Quen 3的偏差最小. 这不仅反映了较弱语言的总体准确度较低。 这表明,即使模型在其他方面能够做出正确的匹配,仍然一贯倾向于英语。

blocks.en: 2 Dataset Description
blocks.zh: 2 数据集描述

blocks.en: MultiInpaintCOCO extends the English InpaintCOCO dataset ( Rösch et al., 2024 ) to 13 more languages, producing a multilingual minimal-pair benchmark for fine-grained vision-language retrieval. The dataset covers 14 languages in total and spans five language families, with translations produced automatically and then post-edited by native speakers.
blocks.zh: 多彩相册 将英语的InpaintCOCO数据集(Rösch等,2024年)扩展至另外13种语言,为精致的视觉语言检索生成了多语种最小的pair基准. 数据集涵盖总共14种语言,覆盖了5个语言家庭,译名自动出炉,后由母语人编辑.

blocks.en: 2.1 InpaintCOCO
blocks.zh: 2.1 印花公司

blocks.en: InpaintCOCO ( Rösch et al., 2024 ) is a minimal-pair dataset built on top of COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) . For each example, a keyword is replaced in the original caption, and the corresponding image region is edited using Stable Diffusion inpainting ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , producing a pair of images that differ in a single localized detail and a pair of captions that reflect that difference. This construction ensures that a model can only retrieve the correct image–caption match by attending to fine-grained visual content rather than overall scene similarity.
blocks.zh: 印地安人组织 (Rösch等,2024年)是一款由COCO顶部所建的最小平面数据集(Lin等,2014年). 对于每一个例子,一个关键词被替换在原标题中,相应的图像区域被用稳定分化插图来编辑(Rombach等,2022年),产生一对在单一本地化细节上不同的图像和一对反映这种差异的字幕. 这种构建确保模型只能通过关注精细的视觉内容而不是整体场景相似性来取回正确的图像-封装匹配.

blocks.en: Before translation, we manually reviewed all 1,260 examples in InpaintCOCO and removed or corrected low-quality instances. We discarded examples in which the inpainted image contained visible artifacts or the edit was too subtle to warrant a different caption, and we corrected captions that were inaccurate or inconsistent with the edited image. After this review, 953 examples remained.
blocks.zh: 在翻译前,我们手动审查了InpaintCOCO的所有1 260个例子,删除或纠正了低质量的例子。 我们抛弃了印有可见文物的图像或编辑过于细微、无法另作说明的例子,我们纠正了不准确或与所编辑的图像不一致的字幕。 经过这次审查,仍有953个实例。

blocks.en: 2.2 Translation Process
blocks.zh: 2.2 翻译过程

blocks.en: For each language, captions were first translated automatically and then post-edited by a native speaker. Three translation systems were available to the annotators: Hunyuan ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) (the WMT25 winner; Kocmi et al., 2025 ), Google Translate, and GPT-4. Annotators were free to choose whichever system they found most useful as a starting point and were instructed to correct any errors in the output. All annotators were native speakers of the target language with an excellent command of English. The translation into Russian was post-edited, with German as the source language. More details about the annotation process are in the Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 对每种语言,标题先是自动翻译,后由讲母语者编辑。 三个翻译系统可供注释员使用: Hunyuan(郑等,2025年)(WMT25得主;Kocmi等,2025年),Google Translate,和GPT-4. 注释员可以自由选择他们认为最有用的任何系统作为起点,并被指示纠正输出中的任何错误. 所有注释员都是目标语言的母语,精通英语。 俄语译名后被编辑,以德语为源语言. 关于注释过程的更详细情况载于附录A。

blocks.en: 2.3 The MultiInpaintCOCO Dataset
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 多彩画公司 数据集

blocks.en: The final dataset covers 14 languages across five language families: Indo-European, Japonic, Turkic, Austroasiatic, and Afro-Asiatic, with Indo-European being the most represented (10 languages). The full list of languages with their metadata is given in Table 7 . The languages vary substantially in their resource levels: following the tiers of Joshi et al. (2020) , the dataset includes four tier-5 languages (English, German, Japanese, Arabic), five tier-4 languages, four tier-3 languages, and one tier-1 language (Azerbaijani). Morphologically, the majority are fusional (10), with two agglutinative languages (Japanese, Azerbaijani) and two isolating languages (English, Vietnamese).
blocks.zh: 最终数据集涵盖印欧语系,雅波克语系,突厥语系,澳语系等5个语言系的14个语言,印欧语系代表最多(10个语言). 附有元数据的语文完整清单见表7。 语言在资源水平上差异很大:按照Joshi等人的分级(2020年),数据集包括4个第5级语言(英语,德语,日语,阿拉伯语),5个第4级语言,4个第3级语言,以及1个第1级语言(阿塞拜疆语). 在口语学上,大多数是聚变(10),有两种杂交语言(日语,阿塞拜疆语)和两种孤立语言(英语,越南语).

blocks.en: The disparity in the availability of pretraining data across our languages is stark. In FineWeb2 ( Penedo et al., 2025 ) , a 20 TB multilingual web corpus covering over 1,000 languages, Russian alone accounts for 6,400 GB, while German and Japanese each contribute around 1,650 GB. At the other extreme, Azerbaijani has only 29 GB of data, roughly 220 times less than Russian. Slovak (92 GB) and Hindi (130 GB) also fall well below the high-resource languages despite having tens of millions of native speakers. This orders-of-magnitude gap in raw text data directly motivates our expectation (and findings) of performance differences across languages in our experiments.
blocks.zh: 我们各语言在提供预培训数据方面存在明显差距。 FineWeb2(Penedo等,2025年)中,20个TB多语种的网络教程涵盖1000多种语言,仅俄语就占了6400GB,而德语和日语各贡献了约1,650GB. 在另一个极端,阿塞拜疆的数据只有29克,大约比俄语低220倍。 斯洛伐克语(92克)和印地语(130克)也远远低于高资源语言,尽管有数千万母语使用者。 原始文本数据中的这种大相径庭直接激发了我们对各种语言在实验中的表现差异的期望(和发现)。

blocks.en: Table 9 places MultiInpaintCOCO in the context of existing multilingual vision-language benchmarks ( Liu et al., 2021 ; Nooralahzadeh and Sennrich, 2023 ; Bugliarello et al., 2022b ; Romero et al., 2024 ; Pfeiffer et al., 2022 ; Schneider and Sitaram, 2024 ) . Most existing benchmarks are either translation-based with a narrow language selection or culturally grounded but limited in scale. MultiInpaintCOCO occupies a distinct position: it is translation-based, enabling direct cross-lingual comparison, and the only benchmark that combines caption-level and image-level minimal pairs, allowing retrieval errors to be attributed to either the text or the visual representation. In terms of linguistic diversity, measured by the Grambank feature inclusion index (GBI; Ploeger et al., 2024 ), our dataset scores 79, which is higher than all other translation-based benchmarks in Table 9 , such as xFlickrCo ( Bugliarello et al., 2022b ) (65) or XTD ( Aggarwal and Kale, 2020 ) (71), and comparable to culturally grounded ones such as KnowRecall ( Wang et al., 2025 ) (77.94) and CVQA ( Romero et al., 2024 ) (88). Still, MultiInpaintCOCO’s 14 languages represent only 19% of the world’s population when considering languages spoken as first languages.
blocks.zh: 表9将多语种的InpaintCO置于现有多语种远景语言基准(Liu等人,2021年;Noorahzadeh和Sennrich,2023年;Bugliarello等人,2022年b;Romero等人,2024年;Pfeiffer等人,2022年;Schneider和Sitaram,2024年)的范围内。 大多数现有基准是以翻译为基础的,语言选择范围狭窄,或者基于文化,但规模有限。 MultiInpaintCOCO占据了独特的位置:它是基于翻译的,可以直接进行跨语言的比较,也是将标题级别和图像级别最小对合并的唯一基准,可以将检索错误归为文本或视觉表现. 就语言多样性而言,以格拉姆克特征包容指数(GBI;Ploeger等,2024年)衡量,我们的数据集得分79分,高于表9中基于翻译的所有其他基准,如xFlickrCo(Bugliarello等,2022b)(65)或XTD(Aggarwal和Kale,2020年)(71),与基于文化的基准,如KnowRecall(Wang等,2025年)(77.94)和CVQA(Romero等,2024年)(88)。 不过,MultiInpaintCO的14种语言在将语言视为第一语言时只占世界人口的19%。

blocks.en: 3 Multilingual Experiments
blocks.zh: 3个多语言实验

blocks.en: We evaluate both dual-encoder and decoder-only models on MultiInpaintCOCO across all 14 languages to assess how well current VL models handle fine-grained visual details in a multilingual setting. Beyond raw model performance, we measure consistency across languages and across models.
blocks.zh: 我们对所有14种语言的多InpaintCOCO上的双编码器模型和只用解码器模型进行评价,以评估当前VL模型如何在多语种环境中处理精细的视觉细节。 除了原始模型性能之外,我们衡量各种语言和模型的一致性。

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Each example in MultiInpaintCOCO consists of an original image–caption pair and an edited image–caption pair. We construct two retrieval subtasks from this structure. In the two-image task ( 2img ), the model is given one caption and two images and must select the image that matches the caption. In the two-caption task ( 2txt ), the model is given one image and two captions and must select the caption that describes the image. In both cases, either the original or the edited item serves as the query, while the two remaining items of the other modality serve as the context.
blocks.zh: MultiInpaintCOCO中的每个例子都包含一对原始图像-封装对和一对已编辑的图像-封装对. 我们从这个结构构建出两个检索子任务. 在双相相任务(2img )中,模型获得一个标题和两个图像,必须选择匹配标题的图像. 在双封装任务(2txt)中,模型被赋予了一幅图像和两幅字幕,必须选择描述图像的字幕. 在这两种情况下,原始项目或经编辑的项目都用作查询,而另一种模式的其余两个项目则用作上下文。

blocks.en: Dual encoders map images and texts independently into a shared embedding space. For each example, we embed both images and both captions and compute all pairwise cosine similarities. The predicted match is the image (or caption) that is most similar to the query. This evaluation protocol follows Rösch et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 双编码器将图像和文本独立映射到共享嵌入空间. 对于每个例子,我们同时嵌入图像和标题,并计算出所有对等的同心素相似性。 预测匹配是和查询最相近的图像(或标题). 本评价协议遵循了Rösch等人(2024年).

blocks.en: Decoder-only models process inputs sequentially. We present the model with both options ( two-image or two-caption ) and a prompt asking which option is correct. The instruction prompt (see Appendix B ) is written in English, regardless of the language of the captions. We are aware that this practice might amplify the English bias. To explore this, we also test with French (a language not in the current dataset), and the strict accuracy is generally lower (Table 23 ), but the differences between languages follow the same patterns. We therefore decide to stick with the English prompts. Because decoder-only models are known to be sensitive to input order ( Wardle and Susnjak, 2024 ; Tian et al., 2025 ) , we evaluate each example in both orders and require both to be correct, yielding eight comparison configurations per example in total (see Table 11 ). A detailed evaluation of the position bias of the models used in this paper is provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 只有解码器的模型按顺序处理输入. 我们用两种选项(双相或双相)呈现模型,并迅速询问哪个选项是正确的. 指示提示(见附录B)是用英文写的,而不论标题的语言如何。 我们知道,这种做法可能会扩大英国人的偏见。 为了探索这一点,我们还用法语进行测试(当前数据集中没有的一种语言),严格准确度一般较低(表23),但语言之间的差异遵循相同的模式. 因此,我们决定坚持英国的要求。 由于已知只有解码器的模型对输入顺序敏感(Wardle和Susnjak, 2024;Tian等, 2025),我们按两个顺序评价每个实例,并要求两者都正确,得出每个实例总共八个比较配置(见表11). 附录C详细评价了本文件所用模型的位置偏差。

blocks.en: We report strict accuracy as a primary metric. A dataset item is counted as correct only if the model answers correctly across all comparison configurations: four for order-invariant dual encoders and eight for decoder-only models.
blocks.zh: 我们报告,严格准确性是主要衡量标准。 只有在模型正确解答所有比较配置时,一个数据集项目才会被计算为正确:4个用于顺序变化的双编码器,8个用于解码器唯一的模型.

blocks.en: 3.2 Tested Models
blocks.zh: 3.2 试验型号

blocks.en: We evaluate two model families: decoder-only generative VL models and dual-encoder CLIP-like models. Tables 12 and 8 provide additional model details.
blocks.zh: 我们评价两个模型家族:解码器唯一基因VL模型和双编码器CLIP类似模型. 表12和8提供了更多的模型细节。

blocks.en: We evaluate five open-weight VL models with a parameter count ranging from 2B to 12B. Gemma 3 ( Team et al., 2025 ) (12B parameters), Qwen VL 2.5 ( Bai et al., 2025b ) (7B), Qwen VL 3 ( Bai et al., 2025a ) (8B), Aya Vision ( Dash et al., 2025 ) (8B), and Jina VL ( Koukounas et al., 2026 ) (2B), the smallest model in our evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了5个可开放重量的VL模型,其参数计数范围从2B到12B. Gemma 3(Team等,2025年)(12B参数),Quen VL 2.5 (Bai等,2025年b)(7B),Quen VL 3(Bai等,2025年a)(8B),Aya Vision (Dash等,2025年b),和Jina VL (Koukonas等,2026年b),是我们评价中最小的模型.

blocks.en:
We evaluate seven CLIP-like models ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , all based on SigLIP ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) . This includes NLLB-SigLIP ( Visheratin, 2023 ) in base and large sizes, MEXMA-SigLIP 2, and SigLIP 2 ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) from base to giant sizes. The vision encoders of SigLIP 2 are also used in Gemma and Qwen.
The NLLB versions consist of the first SigLIP model, pre-trained across all languages in NLLB-200 ( Team et al., 2022 ) . MEXMA-SigLIP 2 combines the MEXMA text encoder ( Janeiro et al., 2024 ) with the SigLIP visual backbone.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了7个类似CLIP的模型(Radford等,2021年),都基于SigLIP(Zhai等,2023年). 这包括基地和大型的NLLB-SigLIP(Visheratin,2023年),MEXMA-SigLIP 2和从基地到大型的SigLIP 2 (Tschannn等,2025年). SigLIP 2的视觉编码器也用于Gemma和Quen.
NLLB版本由首个SigLIP模式组成,在NLLB-200(Team等,2022.)中对所有语言进行预训. 墨西哥-锡格利普 2将MEXMA文本编码器(Janeiro等,2024年)与SigLIP视觉主干线结合.

blocks.en: 3.3 Results
blocks.zh: 3.3 结果

blocks.en: We report the strict accuracy in Table 1 . Table 14 in the appendix contains the accuracy for the 2img task, and Table 15 for 2txt . On average, deciding between two images is slightly harder than deciding between two texts for all the models. This is expected, given that in the 2txt task, the query image is fixed across languages, and errors are driven mainly by shared visual ambiguity. However, in the 2img setup, the query is language-specific, so the per-language text-encoding quality introduces additional variation. The Jina model has the highest modality performance gap, while Qwen 3 has the lowest. Azerbaijani (tier-1) has the lowest performance, which is correlated with it being the least-resourced language we have. On the other hand, with dual encoders that rely on the SigLIP 2 text encoder, we observe a performance drop for Japanese, a high-resource language (tier-5). Moreover, for the same models, the gap between the 2img / 2txt accuracies and strict accuracy is unusually large for Hindi. Finally, MEXMA-SigLIP 2 performs best on Azerbaijani.
blocks.zh: 我们在表1中报告严格准确性。 附录中的表14载有2img任务的准确性,表15为2txt。 平均而言,在两个图像之间作出决定比在所有模型之间决定两个文本要难。 鉴于在2txt任务中,查询图像是跨语言固定的,而错误主要是由共享的视觉模糊来驱动的,因此这是预期的. 然而,在2img设置中,查询是语言特异性的,因此每个语言的文本编码质量引入了额外的变异. Jina模式的性能差距最大,而Quen 3则最低. 阿塞拜疆语(第一级)的表现最低,与之相关联的是,它是我们拥有的资源最少的语言。 另一方面,有了依靠SigLIP 2文本编码器的双重编码器,我们观察到了日语的性能下降,一种高资源语言(第5级). 此外,对于同一种模型来说,2img / 2txt 速率和严格精确度之间的差距对印地语来说异常大. 最后,墨西哥-西格利普 2在阿塞拜疆表现最好。

blocks.en: To verify the robustness of our findings, we estimated 95% confidence intervals using bootstrap resampling with 10K samples (Table 22 ). With 953 examples per language, the intervals are roughly ± 3 \pm 3 percentage points, and the main effects discussed above are statistically significant: the drop for Azerbaijani (with MEXMA-SigLIP 2 significantly outperforming all other models there), the drop for Japanese for SigLIP 2, and the English lead for Aya Vision. The overlapping intervals appear mostly among higher-resource languages and among the strongest models, where performance is similar: e.g., for Qwen 3, all languages except Azerbaijani, Czech, and Slovak overlap with English, and for MEXMA-SigLIP 2, all 14 languages overlap.
blocks.zh: 为了核实我们的调查结果是否可靠,我们估计了95%的置信间隔,使用有10K样本的靴子重新取样(表22)。 每个语言有953个例子,间隔大约为±3\pm 3个百分点,上面讨论的主要影响在统计学上是显著的:阿塞拜疆语的下降(其中MEXMA-SigLIP 2显著地超过了那里所有其他模型),日本语的下降为SigLIP 2,英语的领先为Aya Vision. 重叠的间隔主要出现在资源较高的语言和最强的模型中,其性能相近:例如,对于Quen 3,除了阿塞拜疆语,捷克语和斯洛伐克语的所有语言都与英语相重叠;对于MEXMA-SigLIP 2,所有14个语言都相重叠.

blocks.en:
Table 2 shows Spearman correlations between strict accuracy and a set of language-level variables. The strongest predictor across models is the amount of text in the FineWeb2 corpus ( ρ ¯ = .56 \bar{\rho}=.56 ), an open-source web crawl derived from CommonCrawl that reflects the amount of data realistically available for a given language on the web. The number of Wikipedia articles follows closely ( ρ ¯ = .53 \bar{\rho}=.53 ) and can be understood as a proxy for the same underlying quantity.
Even though the exact amount and composition of the training data are unknown to the public, these two proxy variables suggest that the volume of pretraining data might be the dominant factor in cross-lingual performance differences.

Typological similarity to English correlates moderately ( ρ ¯ = .46 \bar{\rho}=.46 ) and less strongly than data-size proxies, indicating that the volume of training data matters more than cross-lingual transfer from English.
The notably low correlation between English similarity and performance for NLLB-SigLIP models ( .18 .18 for both Base and Large) is consistent with the finding in Section 4 that these models are less English-centric than the rest.
For models with a stronger Chinese component (Qwen family), similarity to Chinese correlates slightly more than similarity to English; averaged over all models, however, the correlation with similarity to Chinese is only .34 .34 .

与英语的字型相似性与中度相关(ρ ρ 46. bar{\rho}= 46.),与数据大小的代词关系更小,表明培训数据量比从英语跨语言传输更重要.
NLLB-SigLIP模型的英语相似度和性能显著的低相关性(Base和Large均为18.18),这与第4节中的结论一致,即这些模型以英语为中心的程度低于其他模型.
对于中文成分较强的模型(Quen family),与中文的相似度略高于与英文的相似度;但对所有模型的平均值,与中文的相似度仅为34.34.

blocks.en:
Languages that require fewer tokens tend to perform better, especially in the SigLIP 2 family and Jina VL, but not in the MEXMA and NLLB families. Among the two largest decoder-only models, this effect is relatively strong for Gemma 3 but much weaker for Qwen 3 VL. However, the average correlation of .30 .30 shows that token count remains only a rough proxy.
A notable counterexample, shown in Table 10 , is that the Qwen tokenizers overtokenize Greek and Hindi by 2.8 × \times compared to English, yet these languages perform comparably to other languages. Meanwhile, Azerbaijani, despite having relatively long tokens, performs much worse.

一个显著的反例如表10所示, Quen语标语比起英语, 与此同时,阿塞拜疆人尽管有相对较长的征兆,但表现却更糟。

blocks.en: Finally, Joshi’s resource tiers are the weakest explanatory factor ( ρ ¯ = .34 \bar{\rho}=.34 ). This is likely for two reasons: the tier classification partly reflects the availability of annotated linguistic resources (treebanks, lexicons, and so on), which are not directly relevant for vision-language pretraining; and the taxonomy is now six years old ( Joshi et al., 2020 ) and might not reflect current data availability. The total number of native speakers is slightly more relevant ( ρ ¯ = .37 \bar{\rho}=.37 ).

blocks.en: 4 Cross-lingual Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个跨文化实验

blocks.en:
Unlike the previous set of experiments, where we tested the models monolingually across all languages, here we test them in a more challenging two-text setup, in which each text is in a different language. This allows us to evaluate whether the models exhibit biases.
We design a set of cross-lingual experiments to measure whether models are biased toward better-resourced languages.
blocks.zh:
与之前的一组实验不同的是,我们对所有语言的模型进行单一语言的测试,这里我们用一个更具挑战性的双文本设置来测试,其中每个文本都使用不同的语言. 这使我们能够评估这些模型是否表现出偏见。
我们设计一套跨语言的实验 来衡量模型是否偏向于资源更好的语言。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en: The least biased model is Qwen 3 with close-to-zero language-specific mistakes in all languages, as displayed in Table 17 . At the opposite extreme, Gemma 3 shows a stronger preference for English than other models, despite its competitive strict accuracy . Gemma disfavors languages using non-Latin scripts (Arabic, Japanese, Ukrainian, Greek, Hindi) as well as Azerbaijani. Aya and Qwen 2.5 show intermediate levels of English bias without strong script-related patterns. Jina VL exhibits an unusual pattern: in addition to preferring English, it strongly favors Hindi while systematically disfavoring Slavic languages, regardless of script.
blocks.zh: 如表17所示,最小偏差的模型是Quen 3,在所有语言中存在近乎零的语言特有错误. Gemma 3在相反的极端, Gemma使用非拉丁文字(阿拉伯语、日语、乌克兰语、希腊语、印地语)以及阿塞拜疆语表示不满。 Aya and Quen 2.5 显示没有强烈的脚本相关图案的英语偏执的中间级别. Jina VL呈现出一种不同寻常的模式:除了偏好英语外,它还强烈地偏好印地语,而同时系统性地反对斯拉夫语,不管脚本如何.

blocks.en:
Dual encoders show less English bias overall (Table 18 ) but differ substantially from one another. The first point is likely because their text towers are trained with a symmetric cross-lingual contrastive objective, whereas decoder-only LMs are pretrained on English-dominant text with vision attached afterward, which plausibly induces a stronger English preference at generation time. NLLB-SigLIP Base is a strong outlier: it is biased against European languages, suggesting that its training on 200 languages with NLLB representations may have introduced an unusual skew.
The Large variant is more balanced, though it retains a dispreference for Czech and Slovak.
MEXMA-SigLIP 2 and the SigLIP 2 family (especially in the base and giant versions) show little bias toward English but exhibit a consistent tendency to penalize Hindi and Japanese, similar to the accuracy drop for Japanese noted in Section 3 .

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
The methodology has been adapted to vision-language models.
Winoground ( Thrush et al., 2022 ) tests whether models can match two images to two captions containing identical words in different orders.
ARO ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2023 ) scales this to 50,000 pairs, targeting relational and attributive understanding.
SugarCrepe ( Dumpala et al., 2024 ) addresses artifacts in earlier benchmarks by using an LLM to generate fluent hard-negative captions.
All of these works focus exclusively on English.
InpaintCOCO ( Rösch et al., 2024 ) extends the paradigm by modifying both the caption and the image via inpainting, introducing genuine visual ambiguity.
We extend InpaintCOCO to 13 more languages.
blocks.zh:
该方法已根据愿景语言模式进行调整。
葡萄园 (Thrush等,2022)测试模型是否能够将两个图像匹配到两个标题,其中包含不同顺序的同名词.
ARO(Yuksekgonul等,2023年)将这个比例缩到5万对,瞄准关系和分解的理解.
SugarCrepe(Dumpala等人,2024年)通过使用LLM生成流畅硬阴性标题,处理早期基准中的文物.
所有这些作品都只以英语为主.
印地安人组织 (Rösch等,2024年)通过涂入来修改标题和图像来扩展范式,引入了真正的视觉模糊.
我们把InpaintCO扩大到另外13种语言。

blocks.en: A survey by Manea and Libovický (2025) identified 23 benchmarks for multilingual vision-language tasks. We refer the reader to that section for a broader overview.
blocks.zh: Manea和Libovický的调查(2025年)为多语种愿景语言任务确定了23个基准。 我们请读者参看该节,以便作更广泛的概述。

blocks.en:
Most existing multilingual benchmarks are either translation-based (XVNLI, xGQA, xFlickrCo; Bugliarello et al. 2022b ; Nooralahzadeh and Sennrich 2023 ) or with region-specific imagery (MARVL, Liu et al. 2021 ; CVQA, Romero et al. 2024 ).
MultiInpaintCOCO is translation-based, enables direct cross-lingual comparison, and is the only benchmark that combines caption-level and image-level minimal pairs, allowing retrieval errors to be attributed to either text or vision understanding.
blocks.zh:
大多数现有的多语种基准是以翻译为基础的(XVNLI, xGQA, xFlickrCo; Bugliarello等2022b;Noorahzadeh和Sennrich 2023),或带有特定区域的图像(MARVL, Liu等. 2021; CVQA, Romero等2024.).
MultiInpaintCOCO是基于翻译的,可以直接进行跨语言比较,是将标题级别和图像级别最小对合并的唯一基准,可以将检索错误归结为文本或视觉理解.

blocks.en:
Language bias in NLP refers to the tendency of multilingual models to favor high-resource languages over lower-resource ones.
Early work showed that multilingual BERT encodes a structural bias toward English, with the grammatical properties of higher-resource languages bleeding into the representations of lower-resource ones ( Papadimitriou et al., 2023 ) .
Nowadays, this bias is particularly pronounced in retrieval settings: in multilingual retrieval-augmented generation, models systematically prefer high-resource language sources, especially English, even when lower-resource language documents are more relevant ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Ki et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
NLP的语言偏好是指多语种模式倾向于高资源语言而不是低资源语言的倾向.
早期的研究表明,多语种BERT将结构偏向于英语,高资源语言的语法特性被流出到低资源语言的表达中去(Papadimitriou等,2023年).
如今,这种偏见在检索设置中尤其明显:在多语种检索增强的生成中,模型系统地倾向于高资源语言来源,特别是英语,即使低资源语言文件更为相关(Wu等,2024;Ki等,2025)。

blocks.en: In vision-language models, related phenomena have been observed, such as models defaulting to English responses regardless of the query language when an image is present ( Hinck et al., 2024 ) , and degraded understanding of non-English text within images ( Geigle et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 在视觉语言模型中,相关现象被观察到了,例如模型默认在图像存在时不使用任何查询语言的英语响应(Hinck等,2024年),图像内部对非英语文本的理解退化(Geigle等,2025年).

blocks.en: However, to the best of our knowledge, none of the previous works conducted a direct study of language bias in a multilingual vision-language retrieval setup.
blocks.zh: 然而,据我们所知,前作中没有一部直接研究多语言视觉语言检索设置中的语言偏差.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en: We introduced MultiInpaintCOCO, a multilingual minimal-pair benchmark for fine-grained vision-language retrieval, extending InpaintCOCO to 13 more typologically diverse languages via automatic translation followed by native-speaker post-editing. The benchmark combines caption-level and image-level minimal pairs, enabling retrieval errors to be attributed to either the textual or visual representation, a combination absent from prior multilingual VL benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了MultiInpaintCO,这是精致的视觉语言检索的多语种最低标准,将InpaintCO扩展至13种类型多样的语言,通过自动翻译,然后是母语编辑。 该基准结合了标题级和图像级的最小对子,使得检索出错可以归结为文字或视觉表现,这是以前多语种VL基准中缺失的组合.

blocks.en: We evaluated five decoder-only and seven dual-encoder models and reported two main findings. First, performance drops substantially for lower-resource languages, with Azerbaijani—the least-resourced language in our study—consistently being the hardest across all models. The strongest predictor of this gap is the volume of pretraining data available for a language, as reflected by web corpus size, rather than typological proximity to English. Second, in cross-lingual retrieval, models exhibit a systematic preference for English captions over correct captions in other languages. This bias is not merely a consequence of lower monolingual accuracy; the tendency persists even in cases where a model would otherwise handle the non-English language well. The bias is strongest in Gemma 3 and weakest in Qwen 3, and it is present in both encoder and decoder architectures, though dual encoders tend to show less English preference overall.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了五个唯一的解码器模型和七个双重编码器模型,并报告了两个主要的调查结果。 首先,资源较低的语言的成绩大幅下降,阿塞拜疆语——我们的研究中资源最少的语言——在所有模式中始终是最困难的。 这一差距的最能预测的是一种语言的预训数据量,这体现在网络体积上,而不是在类型学上接近英语。 第二,在跨语种检索中,模型系统地倾向于英文字幕,而不是其他语文的正确字幕。 这种偏向不仅仅是单一语言准确性较低的结果;即使在模型本来能很好地处理非英语语言的情况下,这种倾向也依然存在。 偏差在Gemma 3中最强,在Quen 3中最弱,同时存在于编码器和解码器架构中,尽管双重编码器在总体上往往表现出较少的英语偏好.

blocks.en: These findings suggest that the English-centric nature of VL pretraining manifests in at least two separable ways: reduced representational capacity for lower-resource languages and an active preference for English during retrieval when English is one of the candidate options.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果表明,VL预训以英语为中心,其表现方式至少有两种:降低资源较少语言的代表能力;在英语为候选选项之一的检索过程中积极偏好英语.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: MultiInpaintCOCO covers 14 typologically diverse languages across five language families. This remains a small fraction of the world’s approximately 7,000 languages, and our findings may not generalize beyond the languages included.
blocks.zh: 多彩相册 涵盖五个语言家庭的14种类型不同的语言。 这仍然是世界约7000种语言的一小部分,我们的结论可能无法超越包括的语言。

blocks.en: Automatic translation followed by native-speaker post-editing may introduce a bias toward grammatically correct but unnaturally formal phrasing, as post-editors tend to preserve the structure of machine-translated output rather than produce fully idiomatic text. Moreover, we did not evaluate the translation quality (e.g., for naturalness, consistency, or difficulty) of our annotated captions across languages. Therefore, we assumed that the low performance is the direct consequence of the models’ abilities.
blocks.zh: 后自译自语的后作会引入对语法正确而非自然的正式用词的偏好,因为后作会倾向于保留机器翻译输出的结构,而不是产生完全平庸的文字. 此外,我们没有评估我们附加说明的语文标题的翻译质量(例如自然性、一致性或难度)。 因此,我们假设低性能是模型能力的直接后果。

blocks.en: Finally, the images in our dataset are drawn from COCO, which predominantly depicts scenes and objects from North America. This introduces a potential confound: strong performance on our benchmark does not necessarily imply that a model handles a given language well in its natural cultural context, since the visual content may be more familiar to models trained on Western-centric data, regardless of the language of the caption.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们数据集中的图像取自COCO,它主要描绘来自北美的场景和物体. 这带来了一种潜在的困惑:在我们的基准上的有力表现并不一定意味着一个模型在自然文化背景下能很好地处理某一语言,因为视觉内容可能更熟悉于以西方为中心的数据所训练的模型,无论标题的语言如何。
